notes:
Background: Mid-market product org building AI-native search + support assistant. Trial started on Hosted API (Nov 2025) -> fast onboarding, good quality. Now moving to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

Key asks / requirements (from PM + infra):
- Workloads: chat for customer support (low-latency), embeddings for semantic search, occasional reranking jobs.
- Perf targets: p95 < 120ms token gen on small chat models; p99 SLA ask: < 300ms at observed 20-30 QPS (important for CX flows).
- Throughput: peak 30 QPS chat, background batch embeddings 50k reqs/day.
- Cost sensitivity: unit cost must be < $0.002/token equivalent vs hosted baseline when on Dedicated.
- Model preferences: open Llama-family + 7B/13B variants for assistants; want option for quantized variants.

Security / compliance checklist:
- Must provide SOC2 Type II report and controls mapping (procurement asked explicitly).
- DPA: retention max 90 days for transients; customer-data residency (US East) required for Dedicated nodes.
- KMS integration: BYOK preferred; key rotation and HSM/KMS audit hooks required.
- SSO via SAML + SCIM user sync for platform console.
- Audit logs retention 1 year; ability to export logs to customer SIEM.

Legal / procurement details so far:
- AE ran pricing scenario with three-node reserved Dedicated + burst policy; high-level pricing accepted by finance prelim.
- Legal submitted redlines to Redwood MSA: primary issues are indemnity, liability cap tied to fees, termination for convenience notice windows, and subcontractor disclosures.
- DPA redlines: stricter deletion timelines, requirement for subprocessors list, audit rights. Procurement asked for a vendor onboarding packet (vendor questionnaire + insurance cert + W9).
- Quote from procurement: "We can move quickly once we get SOC2 + DPA language aligned. Preferred to keep liability cap equal to 1x ARR for first year -- RED FLAG for Redwood."

POC / Technical timeline (bullets):
- 2025-11-20: Hosted API quickstart + sample chat integration. Positive dev feedback, latency under target for dev workload. (ffx_20251120_hosted_log).
- 2026-01-21: Demo of Dedicated architecture + perf numbers (ffx_20260121_nectar-demo-01). SE showed kernel selection and autoscale behavior.
- 2026-01-28: Eng spike with SE (Diego) to validate KV-cache behavior for long chat contexts. Action: provide KV cache tuning guide.
- 2026-02-04: Pricing alignment call with finance; asked for 12-month commit discount and clearer overage terms (gthread_20260204_pricing_negotiation).
- 2026-02-18: Legal sent redlines (drive:/contracts/nectar/redline-msa-2026.docx).

Action items open / responsibilities:
- Redwood: produce vendor security pack (SOC2 attestation, penetration test summary), sample DPA with proposed retention clauses, and BYOK/KMS integration guide. Owner: Diego.
